title: Discrete-Diffusion Posterior Sampling with Langevin-Inspired Proposals
abstract: arXiv:2605.09302v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study posterior sampling for inverse problems in discrete state spaces using discrete diffusion models as generative priors. While continuous diffusion models have become widely used for inverse problems, their discrete counterparts remain comparatively underexplored. Existing discrete posterior samplers often rely on continuous relaxations of discrete variables, Gibbs-style updates, or mechanisms specialized to particular corruption processes, which can limit scalability or generality. We propose $\Delta$LPS, a Discrete Langevin-Inspired Posterior Sampler that uses gradient information to identify promising discrete moves without leaving the discrete state space. The resulting approach enables efficient parallel updates across all token dimensions and is agnostic to the training paradigm of the discrete diffusion prior, including masked and uniform-state diffusion. We evaluate our method on image restoration tasks across MNIST, C

translated_title: 基于朗之万启发性提议的离散扩散后验采样
translated_abstract: 我们研究利用离散扩散模型作为生成先验，在离散状态空间中求解逆问题的后验采样。虽然连续扩散模型已被广泛应用于逆问题，但其离散对应方法仍相对缺乏探索。现有的离散后验采样器通常依赖于离散变量的连续松弛、Gibbs式更新，或针对特定损坏过程设计的专用机制，这可能限制其可扩展性或通用性。我们提出ΔLPS（Discrete Langevin-Inspired Posterior Sampler），一种离散朗之万启发的后验采样器，它利用梯度信息来识别有前景的离散移动，而不离开离散状态空间。该方法能够在所有token维度上实现高效的并行更新，并且与离散扩散先验的训练范式无关，包括掩码扩散和均匀状态扩散。我们在MNIST等数据集的图像修复任务上评估了我们的方法。
tldr: 该论文提出ΔLPS，一种利用梯度信息在离散状态空间内引导离散移动的朗之万启发式后验采样器，可跨所有token维度高效并行更新，且兼容掩码和均匀状态等多种离散扩散先验训练范式，从而在离散状态空间中高效求解逆问题的后验采样。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ΔLPS, a Langevin-inspired posterior sampler that uses gradient information to identify promising discrete moves without leaving the discrete state space, enabling efficient parallel updates across all token dimensions and remaining agnostic to the training paradigm of discrete diffusion priors, for efficient posterior sampling of inverse problems in discrete state spaces.
